title: Geometry optimization
action: Perform DFT geometry optimization for all five Pb-Ba intermetallic compounds (BaPb3, Ba3Pb5, BaPb, Ba5Pb3, Ba2Pb) and for pure Pb and Ba, using the LDA CA-PZ functional and ultrasoft pseudopotentials. Start from the experimental crystal structures provided in the task instructions. Obtain optimized lattice parameters and total energies.
description: Required reference calculation to obtain optimized structures and total energies needed for formation enthalpies and subsequent steps.

title: Elastic constant calculation
action: Apply strain perturbations to the optimized structures of each compound and perform DFT total-energy calculations. Extract the elastic constants C_ij from the energy versus strain data, using the strain patterns appropriate for each crystal system (trigonal, orthorhombic, tetragonal).
description: Needed to derive the polycrystalline elastic moduli.

title: Electronic structure calculation
action: Calculate the band structure and total and partial density of states (DOS) for each compound. For Ba2Pb, determine the direct band gap from the band structure. Integrate the total DOS below the Fermi level over the energy range -4 eV to 0 eV to obtain the bonding electron numbers per atom.
description: Provides bonding electron counts and Ba2Pb band gap.

title: Compute final properties
action: From the total energies of optimized compounds and elements, compute formation enthalpies per atom. Using the elastic constants, derive isotropic polycrystalline moduli (bulk B, shear G, Young's E, Poisson's ν) via Voigt-Reuss-Hill averaging. Compute the density from the optimized volume and composition; then calculate sound velocities and the Debye temperature. Also compute the Vickers hardness H_V for each compound from G and B using the semi-empirical Tian equation H_V = 0.92 * (G/B)^{1.137} * G^{0.708}. Calculate the elastic anisotropy indexes: the universal anisotropy index A^U, the percent anisotropies A_B and A_G, and the shear anisotropic factors A1, A2, A3, using the elastic constants and the Voigt/Reuss bounds. Assemble all results, together with bonding electron numbers and the Ba2Pb band gap, into a single JSON file. List the compounds in order of most negative to least negative formation enthalpy.
description: Collects all headline quantities including hardness and anisotropy into one checkable artifact; its values depend on the preceding DFT calculations.
output_schema: A JSON object with keys for each compound ('BaPb3', 'Ba3Pb5', 'BaPb', 'Ba5Pb3', 'Ba2Pb'). Each key maps to an object containing numeric fields: 'formation_enthalpy' (kJ/mol), 'bulk_modulus' (GPa), 'shear_modulus' (GPa), 'youngs_modulus' (GPa), 'poissons_ratio' (dimensionless), 'debye_temperature' (K), 'bonding_electron_number' (dimensionless), 'hardness' (GPa), and an 'anisotropy' sub-object with numeric fields 'A_U', 'A_B', 'A_G', 'A1', 'A2', 'A3' (all dimensionless). Top-level field 'Ba2Pb_band_gap' (eV). Top-level list 'stability_order' with compound names from most negative formation enthalpy to least negative.
